description: Pixel-diff a built frame against a reference node. Both render at the reference's effective scale; returns mismatchPercent, a per-quadrant breakdown (tl/tr/bl/br), the size delta and paths to the diff/ref/built PNGs. A mismatch in one quadrant usually means one misplaced element.

inlineDiff.description: Also return the diff PNG inline

threshold.description: pixelmatch colour threshold (0 = exact, 1 = anything matches)

name: figma_compare_to_reference
